483-2393-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-2393-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1432-2645-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

512-1336-5475.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
512-1336-5475.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1336-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-1879-4186-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3284-4247-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4247-4550-4871.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

277-4772-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3179-4399-4518-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3179-4399-4518-6458.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-6458.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

862-4336-5860-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-4336-5860-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1895-2350-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-4871-5686-7316.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1494-3365-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Aeromoeba by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

643-3490-4659-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
643-3490-4659-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Maskwood Nexus, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

141-5256-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5256-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

215-3464-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 5 or greater.
215-3464-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-7084-7316.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-7084-7316.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

5361-7009-7309.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

331-3011-6899.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
331-3011-6899.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to With Great Power....
331-3011-6899.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

338-2541-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Brallin has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
338-2541-4703.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Brallin triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1563-2457-5223.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

856-4321-5147-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5147-6351.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2781-5231-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {R}.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1365-4853-5147-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4853-5147-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1651-2797-4094-4659.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1651-2797-4094-4659.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

539-2719-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2097-4716-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prosperous Innkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Prosperous Innkeeper dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Prosperous Innkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1651-2751-4155-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least two descent counters on it.
1651-2751-4155-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Stasis Coffin by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it, giving you protection from everything until end of turn.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Descent into Avernus' ability.
Resolve the copy of Descent into Avernus' ability, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on it, and then deal that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 3.

618-914-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
618-914-2816.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it to create a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist copy enters, triggering to create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping them and sacrificing, adding {3}.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by paying {3} and untapping Kiki-Jiki to give Kiki-Jiki +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1636-1894-4599.notablePrerequisites: At least four other Zombies on the battlefield.
1636-1894-4599.description:
Sacrifice Bile Urchin to have target opponent lose 1 life.
Tap 5 untapped zombies you control to return Bile Urchin to the battlefield.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1778-3249-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Memnite.
Cast Memnite from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
